statement: Old Babylonian scribal education included formal cuneiform copying exercises in Sumerian and Akkadian; surviving school tablets show students practicing signs, words, and multiplication/metrological material.

sources.citation: Metropolitan Museum of Art, “Cuneiform tablet: student exercise tablet,” Old Babylonian, ca. 20th–16th century BCE.
sources.author: Metropolitan Museum of Art

sources.citation: CDLI P254492 (MCT 021, UM 29.15.480), Old Babylonian Nippur school exercise / multiplication table.
sources.author: Cuneiform Digital Library Initiative

notes: Attests specialist/school knowledge; it does not establish population-wide literacy.
